open_points.subject: context — pre-export correction of imported room names
open_points.text: The import renames no room: it stores a picked project's rooms under the names the v1 instance gave them (A16), and a room is never renamed or removed afterwards (R0-10). So the owner, before making the export on the VPS (R0-72), corrects there every room name of the projects to be picked that breaks this rule (owner, 2026-11-23, State 0 round-59 T1).
open_points.question: When a picked VPS project has a room name that breaks R0-96, may the owner rename that existing room before export despite R0-10, or must the project remain unchanged and therefore be excluded or imported with the prohibited name?
options: Permit a one-time pre-export rename as an explicit exception to R0-10.
Forbid renaming under R0-10 and exclude every affected project from the import.
Forbid renaming and import the affected room name unchanged, accepting that R0-96's required pre-export correction was not performed.
open_points.default_guess: Permit a narrowly stated one-time pre-export rename on the VPS before the export, explicitly narrowing R0-10 for this migration cleanup.

witness.initial: A VPS project selected for import has an existing room named "Bathroom for María's wheelchair", which breaks R0-96.
events: The owner reviews the selected project's room names before making the export.
R0-96 requires the owner to correct this room name on the VPS.
R0-10 says the existing room is never renamed or removed.
The owner exports the project and Registry imports its rooms under the names present in that export.
outcomes: Following R0-96, the owner renames the existing room before export and the imported room has the corrected neutral name.
Following R0-10, the owner cannot rename the room; the project must be excluded or the imported room retains the prohibited name.
witness.observer: The owner and every reader of the imported project's rooms see whether the original or corrected room name arrived.
